title: Simvastatin and Metformin Therapy in PCOS Women. Prospective Randomised Trial.

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study is to compare effects of statins (simvastatin) and metformin on clinical (menstrual cycle, excessive hair, skin problems), endocrine (androgens), metabolic (lipids, markers of systemic inflammation), and endothelial function parameters in women with polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
